package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestReadyzReportsBoundedTeacherCapabilities(t *testing.T) {
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil)
	handler := HealthHandler{
		Ready: func(context.Context) error { return nil },
		Capabilities: map[string]string{
			"teacher_dialog_v2_reader":        "true",
			"teacher_dialog_dense_claiming":   "false",
			"teacher_dialog_rollout_sequence": "teacher-schema-reader-then-claim-then-dialog-producer",
		},
	}
	handler.Readyz(recorder, request)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"ready","teacher_dialog_v2_reader":"true","teacher_dialog_dense_claiming":"false","teacher_dialog_rollout_sequence":"teacher-schema-reader-then-claim-then-dialog-producer"}`, recorder.Body.String())
}

func TestReadyzReturnsOnlyMappedStaticFailureCode(t *testing.T) {
	known := errors.New("synthetic-known-readiness-failure")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		err  error
		body string
	}{
		{"known", fmt.Errorf("private-token synthetic-student-id: %w", known), `{"status":"not ready","error_code":"dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"}`},
		{"unknown", errors.New("private-token synthetic-student-id private-response-body"), `{"status":"not ready"}`},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			handler := HealthHandler{
				Ready: func(context.Context) error { return test.err },
				ReadinessFailureCode: func(err error) string {
					if errors.Is(err, known) {
						return "dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2"
					}
					return ""
				},
				Capabilities: map[string]string{"private-capability": "must-not-leak-on-failure"},
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.Readyz(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil))
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
			require.JSONEq(t, test.body, response.Body.String())
			require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "private-token")
			require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "synthetic-student-id")
			require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "private-response-body")
			require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "must-not-leak-on-failure")
		})
	}
}

func TestReadyzMissingCheckAndUnmappedFailureKeepExistingShape(t *testing.T) {
	for _, handler := range []HealthHandler{
		{},
		{Ready: func(context.Context) error { return errors.New("private-dependency-error") }},
		{ReadinessFailureCode: func(error) string { t.Fatal("missing check must not invoke mapper"); return "" }},
	} {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.Readyz(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/readyz", nil))
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, response.Code)
		require.JSONEq(t, `{"status":"not ready"}`, response.Body.String())
	}
}
